text: 4 points Consider T which is a reference to the root node of a binary search tree. Let PrintDepth(77) be a procedure that prints the nodes in 7" at depth i. The pseudo-code for this procedure is given below: PrintDepth(T’, 1) if i = 0 print T.key else PrintDepth(T.left,i — 1) PrintDepth(T.right,i — 1) Using the procedure above, your job is to write a procedure that prints the nodes of a BST level by level.
